gloss: ritual burning of old charms and talismans

definitions.gloss: ritual burning of old charms, talismans, and sacred objects
definitions.explanation: A Shinto or Buddhist rite in which old お{札|ふだ}, お{守|まも}り, and other sacred objects are respectfully burned at a shrine or temple, returning them to the gods. It is held so that items containing spiritual power are not simply thrown away.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦お{札|ふだ}→お札：06190_ofuda⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: I take my old talismans to be ritually burned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A ritual burning was held at the shrine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎる→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: After New Year's passes, I have my old amulets ritually burned.

notes:
From the verb ⟦{焚|た}く→焚く：02285_taku⟧ (to burn, to kindle) with the honorific お prefix. Frequently used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: お{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, お{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Most common in early January, when New Year's decorations and the previous year's ⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧ are burned
- The well-known fire festival どんど{焼|や}き is one form of お{焚|た}き{上|あ}げ
- Reflects the belief that sacred objects should be returned to the divine, not discarded as ordinary trash
